statistic: mean^2 / var of intensity (DN^2) per patch

patch.tiling: non-overlapping tiles anchored at the raster origin; a partial tile at the right or bottom edge is dropped
patch.inclusion_rule: a patch is used only if EVERY pixel is inside the mask

mode_estimator.bin_edges: numpy.histogram default: equal width over [min, max] of the per-patch values
mode_estimator.location: exp of the midpoint of the fullest bin
mode_estimator.why_mode: texture only lowers mean^2/var, so the homogeneous population is the upper mode, not the centre
mode_estimator.alternative_reported: mean, p5, p25, median, p75, p95 of the same per-patch distribution

amplitude_mask.used_for: every per-pixel statistic, the screening (CPR > 1 and DOP < 0.13) and the Wilson denominator (measured_pixels)

screening_mask.definition: identical to the amplitude mask -- valid_native.tif is the amplitude mask written to disk

enl_measurement_mask.definition: amplitude mask eroded by a 5x5 structuring element (the 5x5 boxcar footprint), so no window reaches a zero-fill pixel
enl_measurement_mask.used_for: the raw and boxcar ENL rows (enl.json::boxcar_gain) and every bootstrap interval

block.resampling_unit: one row of the 16x16 patch grid
block.construction: the patch grid is (rows, cols); a replicate draws rows with replacement and pools every finite positive patch ratio in the drawn rows
block.why: azimuth lag-1 correlation is +0.838; a row keeps the along-azimuth dependence inside the unit

bootstrap.statistic_bootstrapped: mode_of over the resampled patch ratios

boxcar.applied_to: DN^2 before the patch statistic, for the post-boxcar ENL only
